title: Montserrat & The Black Madinna
text: Sandra was an excellent guide. We enjoyed  seeing the monastery, especially the Black Madonna.  We would recommend this tour!
author: Tracy_K

title: Montserrat/Black Madonna
text: The tour was fabulous. The views were spectacular!! The church and monastery were something special. Our guide Mirium was knowledgeable. She was a wealth of information.
author: Mayra_P

title: Fantastic Day trip ! Jose ( our tour guide ) made the trip memorable
text: Montserrat tour is a must for anybody visiting Barcelona as a tourist . The day trip is smooth and the ride is wonderful . The commentary of our intelligent guide Jose’ made it all the more interesting . Jose’ has a sense of history and communicates very well in English . He also has a very good sense of humour . The trip was truly memorable , so is the guide !!!
author: Naveen_T

title: Unforgettable Visit
text: It is a deeply spiritual experience. The scenery is lovely and seeing the Black Madonna a once in a lifetime opportunity.
author: Jane_T

title: Top!
text:
Everything incredible! 
The guide, José, was incredibly informed and available.  The trip was super smooth and José was super informative.
author: Marisa_P

title: Amazing in depth Montserrat experience! Totally worth it!
text:
This tour fit perfectly into our time in Barcelona! The tour gave us a run down of the Monserrat Monestary finishing with the Black Madonna. After that we had free time to explore on our own which I took the tram to the top of the mountain while my wife stayed and browsed the shops. 

This was a great tour and the tour guide Sarah was very knowledgeable. Maps were supplied once we reached the site. title: our guide Jonathan...
text:
our guide Jonathan excellent, interesting knowledge and anecdotes 
he did not just limit himself to the surroundings of Montserrat but also to other locations along the way.
author: Mario_D

title: The tour was well...
text: The tour was well organized and informative. Even though it was a rainy day, we really enjoyed seeing all that we saw.
author: Timothy_D

title: Loved it! Will recommend!
text: Loved it!  The trip was very smooth but the weather was sadly rain.  In any case, the driver and guide Jessica was great.  Thank you!
author: Hitoshi_Y

title: Montserrat Tour with Miri - 5 stars!
text: Our tour guide Miri was very knowledgeable and so friendly! She led us on a wonderful tour of Montserrat! She shared many things that we would never have known otherwise. The tour itself was well-organized and just the right amount of time to see ever wanted to!
author: Barbara_S
